theorems.name: Submission.bv_ext_norm_fderiv_infDist_eq_one
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (S : Set (Rn n)) (x : Rn n), IsClosed S → S.Nonempty → x ∉ S → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y ↦ infDist y S) x → ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ infDist y S) x‖ = 1
